title: auto collect all cash keyless v2
features: it will automatically collect all cash
script:
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").RemoteEvents.CollectMoney

-- This will run forever until you stop the script
while true do
    -- Loop through all 40 slots
    for i = 1, 40 do
        local slotName = "Slot" .. i
        remote:FireServer(slotName)
    end
    
    -- Wait 0 seconds before collecting everything again
    -- You can change "0" to any number of seconds you want
    task.wait()
end
